description: This file contains interface definitions for various grain types used in Orleans testing, including activation and collection-specific behaviors.

classes.name: IIdleActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: Interface for a grain with idle activation behavior, identified by a GUID key.

classes.name: IIdleActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: Interface for another grain with idle activation behavior, identified by a GUID key.

classes.name: IBusyActivationGcTestGrain1
classes.description: Interface for a busy activation grain with methods for NOP, delay, and identification.

classes.name: IBusyActivationGcTestGrain2
classes.description: Interface for a second busy activation grain with a NOP method.

classes.name: ICollectionSpecificAgeLimitForTenSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with a specific age limit of ten seconds.

classes.name: ICollectionSpecificAgeLimitForZeroSecondsActivationGcTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain with a zero-second age limit.

classes.name: IStatelessWorkerActivationCollectorTestGrain1
classes.description: Interface for a stateless worker grain with methods for NOP, delay, and identification.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Asynchronous method to delay execution for a specified TimeSpan.

methods.name: IdentifyActivation
methods.description: Asynchronous method to identify the activation instance.
